commands.name: due
commands.description: Add, update and close deadlines shown above the prompt
commands.argumentHint: add | next | done | here | rm | list | hide | show
commands.output: No deadlines. Add one: /due add <name> <date> [next step]

tools.name: set_next_step
tools.description: Set the next step of one of the person's deadlines, shown above their prompt. Use it when they finish a step or say what comes next.

tools.name: mark_done
tools.description: Close one of the person's deadlines once they say it is delivered or no longer needed.

tools.name: add_deadline
tools.description: Add a deadline the person mentions ("the deck is due Friday") to the list shown above their prompt.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
/due → No deadlines. Add one: /due add <name> <date> [next step]

types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: due-band.loaded, due-band.now, due-band.isHidden, due-band.cwd, due-band.nudged

./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=due}, tool.call{tool=mcp__due-band__set_next_step}, tool.call{tool=mcp__due-band__mark_done}, tool.call{tool=mcp__due-band__add_deadline}, prompt.compose, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}
